protocol.hypothesis: Context known at a closing record high adds information about subsequent depth beyond price history and climatology.
protocol.selection: First strict available-history record close after a 252-session warmup and the previous selected decision plus 3 calendar months plus one day. Selection uses past/current data only.

horizons.1M: Maximum drawdown from a rolling closing peak over one calendar month after decision availability.
horizons.UNTIL_RECOVERY: Original anchor loss until the first subsequent close >= anchor. If the next close sets/recovers the record, label is zero. No future requirement to drop 3%.

protocol.status: EXPLORATORY: prior studies inspected these calendar years; not a pristine holdout.
